description: This file defines classes and functions related to Jiterator, a CUDA kernel generator for elementwise operations in PyTorch. It includes code parsing, kernel creation, and execution logic for CUDA-based tensor operations.

classes.name: _CodeParser
classes.description: Parses CUDA kernel code strings to extract template parameters, return type, function name, parameters, and body.

classes.name: _JittedFunction
classes.description: Represents a CUDA Jiterator kernel, supports invocation with tensors, manages kernel compilation and launch.

methods.name: _create_jit_fn
methods.description: Creates a CUDA kernel function for elementwise operations using Jiterator, supports inlining and caching.

methods.name: _create_multi_output_jit_fn
methods.description: Creates a CUDA kernel function that supports multiple outputs for elementwise operations.
